description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT against tables staged on a Eurostat dataframe canvas, reaching observations beyond an inline preview and aggregating or joining tables without re-fetching Eurostat. Call eurostat_dataframe_describe first for table and column names. Only a single SELECT runs: statement chaining, non-SELECT verbs, and functions reading files or external data are rejected. Columns are flat: dimension codes, obs_value, obs_flag / obs_flag_label, and conf_status / conf_status_label. Tables eurostat_query_dataset staged also carry dimension _label companions; DS-* tables also carry obs_value_text for published text values. Join observation tables on dimension codes and time. A staged dimension value list has code and label columns; join it to an observation dimension code to add labels. Returns every complete row the canvas supplies, bounded only by the canvas row limit; nested cells render as lossless JSON. A row-limit cut sets truncated and adds a notice: page the same deterministic SELECT over unchanged tables with a total ORDER BY and LIMIT/OFFSET, advancing by actual rowCount. Restart an unordered first page sorted at offset zero; tied keys need tie-breakers. Volatile SQL and changing or expired tables cannot provide stable paging.

canvas_id.description: Canvas identifier returned as canvasId by eurostat_query_dataset, eurostat_download_dataset, or eurostat_get_dimension_values. Identifies the workspace holding the staged tables.

sql.description: A single read-only SELECT statement. Reference tables by the names eurostat_dataframe_describe reports. Example: SELECT geo, geo_label, AVG(obs_value) AS mean FROM df_a1b2c3d4 WHERE time >= '2020' GROUP BY geo, geo_label ORDER BY mean DESC.

name: eurostat_dataframe_query

canvasId.description: Canvas identifier the query ran against.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_disabled`: This deployment runs without a dataframe canvas, so there is nothing to query. `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id is unknown or its lifetime has elapsed. `missing_table`: The SQL names a table that is not staged on this canvas, or that has expired. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Whole-row cut disclosure and deterministic SQL paging guidance. Omitted when no rows were omitted.

rowCount.description: Complete rows returned after the canvas row limit. Advance SQL OFFSET by this actual count.

rows.description: Complete result rows, keyed by column name, bounded by the canvas row limit. Nested cells render as JSON; 64-bit integers arrive as strings so they survive intact. Cast to DOUBLE in SQL if a number is wanted.

truncated.description: True when the canvas row limit omitted rows. Follow notice for SQL paging.

title: Query Eurostat Dataframes
